info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Wholesale Trading Dealer Desk API
info.description: The Wholesale Trading Dealer Desk API facilitates streamlined transaction management within the wholesale banking sector. This API enables users to initiate and manage dealer desk operations, enhancing efficiency and accuracy in trade execution. Typical consumers include financial institutions, brokers, and trading platforms looking to automate and optimize their trading processes. It serves as a critical component for integrating trading functionalities into broader financial services.

post.summary: Create a new dealer desk for wholesale trading.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new dealer desk within the wholesale trading environment. Ensure that you provide all required details in the request body to successfully create the desk.

requestBody.description: This request body represents the data structure required to create or update a dealer desk entry in the wholesale trading operations. It contains all necessary fields to properly initialize or modify the dealer desk information.
